output.summary: Arts' 6-day gap is mostly SlotBook: 1,610 tickets (42%) routed to P4 best-effort under RR-17, which explains 70% of the gap. Excluding SlotBook, Arts matches other faculties by category and priority. The remaining gap comes from Tuesday/Thursday-only on-site cover at Lindqvist, which Education shares. Deprioritisation of Arts is contradicted. Arts volume and trivial-ticket claims are not borne out: non-SlotBook volume is 1.6x, with duplicate rates equal. P4 acknowledgements give requesters no notice of best-effort status. Whether Arts leadership was told of RR-17 is unestablished, and the SSO link is unverified. Prefer a written support agreement, a fixed acknowledgement and matched reporting. Blanket P4 for Arts, the Arts-run desk and rushed decommissioning are not justified.
